commands.name: projects.list
commands.description: List the LaTeX projects in Scribella, e.g. "what papers do I have".

commands.name: project.open
commands.description: Open a LaTeX project in Scribella by name.

commands.name: project.create
commands.description: Create a LaTeX project in Scribella from a starter and open it.

template.description: article, beamer, ieee, acm, thesis, blank, neurips-2026, icml-2026, iclr-2026, acl or cvpr-2027

commands.name: files.list
commands.description: List the files of the open Scribella project.

commands.name: file.read
commands.description: Read a text file of the open Scribella project.

commands.name: file.write
commands.description: Replace the text of a file in the open Scribella project, creating it if needed.

commands.name: build.run
commands.description: Compile the open Scribella project and report whether it built, with its errors.

commands.name: problems.list
commands.description: List the errors and warnings from the last Scribella build in plain words.

commands.name: file.rename
commands.description: Rename a file in the open Scribella project.

commands.name: search.find
commands.description: Search the text files of the open Scribella project.

commands.name: search.todos
commands.description: List TODO, FIXME and \todo notes in the open Scribella project.

commands.name: search.replace
commands.description: Replace text across the open Scribella project.

commands.name: pdf.locate
commands.description: Find where a source line of the open Scribella project lands in the PDF.

commands.name: pdf.source
commands.description: Find the source line behind a point of the Scribella PDF, in PDF points from the top left of the page.

commands.name: versions.list
commands.description: List the saved versions of the open Scribella project.

commands.name: versions.save
commands.description: Save a named version of the open Scribella project.

commands.name: versions.changes
commands.description: Show a PDF of what changed since a saved Scribella version.

commands.name: arxiv.pack
commands.description: Make an arXiv zip of the open Scribella project, with comments removed, and check that it builds alone.

commands.name: notes.list
commands.description: List the notes and highlights in the open Scribella project.

commands.name: notes.add
commands.description: Add a note on a quoted passage of a Scribella file.

commands.name: notes.resolve
commands.description: Mark a Scribella note resolved.

commands.name: references.add
commands.description: Add a paper to the Scribella bibliography by arXiv id, DOI or exact title.

commands.name: references.check
commands.description: Check the Scribella bibliography against Crossref, with retraction notices.

commands.name: submission.check
commands.description: Check a Scribella paper for anything that reveals its authors before double-blind submission.

commands.name: file.format
commands.description: Tidy the indentation of the open Scribella LaTeX file.

commands.name: setup.check
commands.description: Check Scribella's storage, TeX and AI setup.
